title: Pip and Fig at the Pond
note: b416 — Phase 3 continues (Learning) — new sounds zz, qu, ch.

pages.brief: Pip the sparrow hopping along the grassy bank towards a round pond.
Fig the caterpillar stuck in a patch of dark mud at the edge of the pond, looking worried.
Fig the caterpillar wriggling but unable to climb out of the mud.
Pip the sparrow gripping a stem and tugging gently at Fig with his beak.
Fig the caterpillar still held fast in the thick mud, Pip pulling hard.
Pip the sparrow pulling again and again, wings braced for effort.
Fig the caterpillar popping free of the mud in a small splash.
Pip the sparrow and Fig the caterpillar sitting together on the bank, both relieved and happy.
